dog.description_text:
Meet Umaga!

Umaga is a gentle girl with a curious mind and a sweet little personality! She enjoys taking in her surroundings and watching the world around her, always discovering something new along the way.

One of the quickest ways to get Umaga’s attention is with some yummy treats! If she knows you have something tasty to share, you might even hear an adorable little meow from her. It’s her own special way of letting you know she’s interested!

Umaga is a young girl with so much to discover, and getting to know her is part of the fun. If you’re looking for a curious companion who might just chirp her way into your heart, Umaga is ready to meet you!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
